svg.title: Тяга вертикального блока за голову — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Behind-the-neck lat pulldown, draw BOTH panels from directly behind the seated athlete, looking at his back and rear hair. Include tall machine with high pulley and seat, stable thigh pads. One wide straight lat bar connected at midpoint to high pulley cable. Both hands grasp its ends overhand. LEFT arms extended overhead holding bar high. RIGHT pulls bar DOWN behind his head to nape/upper trapezius height. Crucial for rear camera: bar crosses visibly IN FRONT OF the back of the neck from the viewer perspective and both rear deltoids below, hair and ears above bar. Do not put bar on face or front of chest. Neutral neck, both feet grounded. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
